property_summary: Invariant: Only the contract owner can successfully withdraw the contract's balance via withdrawAll (so address(c).balance becomes 0 only when called by the owner); the mutant removing the onlyOwner check allows non-owners to drain the contract, violating this rule for some caller addresses and balances.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove the require), so withdrawAll can be called by non-owners and thus change who receives funds.
